decisions.reason: The optical spectrum service moved from its own page to the home page in 2019, which signals growing strategic value in a wholesale fibre market where demand from carriers and data centres is rising, so the option is worth keeping and expanding.

The number ordering portal is a cheap supporting tool for the voice wholesale business, and since it survived the 2019 pruning of other voice products, keeping it costs little, though declining legacy voice demand leaves some risk of abandonment.
